REASONING: Clause [196] closes work/mutation/integration and increments ENGINEERING_EPOCH but does not freeze current-epoch membership membership records.
Clause [197] explicitly permits real post-barrier joins for closure/review/audit/read-only verification.
Clauses [200]-[209] pin MEMBERSHIP_ROOT_HASH and DRAIN_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH, but membership shards are bulk control state and can change without a Mission Fence STATE_VERSION mutation.
A closure actor can verify M0/D0, then a permitted post-barrier join writes M1 after the final root read but before the [215] expected-version COMPLETE CAS.
Because the membership write need not alter Mission Fence STATE_VERSION, the COMPLETE CAS can still succeed against the same expected fence version.

Clause [216] semantically says ANY CHANGE must REOPEN, but the protocol supplies no atomic coupling that makes a concurrent membership/drain-universe change observable by the [215] CAS. The defect is therefore a TOCTOU safety gap, not merely wording ambiguity.
MINIMUM_SAFE_REPAIR_PROPERTIES: Freeze the closure membership universe with an immutable cutoff before root pinning, OR make every post-barrier closure-universe membership change mutate an authority object observed by the COMPLETE CAS.
Require exact equality for MEMBERSHIP_ROOT_HASH and DRAIN_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH at the final COMPLETE transition, not only during earlier sweeps.
Bind the complete [209] pinned-world tuple to final closure authority, including test-environment, control-P0 root, engineering epoch, and closure generation.
Route post-barrier audit-only joins outside the pinned closure membership universe if they are not intended to invalidate it.
AUTHORITY_NOTE: A stronger control implementation may mitigate the runtime race, but a static P0 raised against the effective Constitution cannot be declared resolved merely by undocumented implementation convention; resolution needs an authoritative protocol interpretation/repair and independent evidence.
